dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: non-germinal-center B-cell-like by the Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.note: Says "ABC-like by IHC" and that GEP would refine, but never states Hans is not equivalent to molecular ABC.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: Bulky disease (retroperitoneal mass 10 cm or more).

mn_stage_iv.quote: so I stage IV rather than III-S

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.note: Labels spleen as extranodal in IPI scoring though it does not change the score.

mol_de_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor DLBCL by IHC (MYC in 50% of tumor cells, above the 40% cut-off; BCL2 in 80%, above the 50% cut-off), but NOT double-hit or triple-hit.

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI is 3 (age over 60, LDH elevated, stage IV), which is high-intermediate
prog_ipi_3.note: Total and category correct but derived from wrong stage IV.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.note: Correct score though it calls the spleen an extranodal site (only one, so scores 0).

tx_pola_preferred.quote: it is a preferred NCCN first-line regimen as I know the guideline
tx_pola_preferred.note: Pola-R-CHP preferred, but no mention of greater benefit in non-GCB disease.

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: if confirmed residual disease, involved-site radiation (around 30 Gy) to the bulk

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily (or tenofovir alafenamide 25 mg daily) before the first rituximab dose, continued at least 12 months after the last rituximab

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: HBV prophylaxis as above, with LFTs and HBV DNA every 1-3 months during therapy.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no prophylactic intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate now.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Deauville 1-3: complete metabolic response, no radiation, surveillance.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 with residual retroperitoneal uptake: biopsy if feasible

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: oral hydration, allopurinol (or febuxostat) starting before C1 for uric acid 7.1 mg/dL

work_echo_reviewed.quote: He is fit for full dose: age 62, ECOG 1, LVEF 58% with GLS -20%

fit_full_dose.quote: Fit for full-intensity curative therapy: age 62, ECOG 1, LVEF 58%
